companyName: Digital Realty Northern Virginia Hyperscale Data Center JV
rationale: The only requested-manager exposure is one 80% interest held through TPG Real Estate Partners, TPG's opportunistic real-estate strategy. Under the fixed census rule, the investment mandate controls rather than the underlying data-center asset type. Digital Realty retained 20% and operating responsibility. The historical three-building JV remains supported, but it does not qualify as direct infrastructure-fund ownership.
recommendedChanges: Exclude the holding from the direct infrastructure-equity PortCo census while preserving the 2023 transaction history.
Consolidate the existing TPG and TPG Real Estate owner labels into one 80% TREP interest.
Retain Digital Realty's 20% co-owner and operating role in the historical record.
Use Nova DC Holdings as the disclosed JV holding identity and keep ACC5, ACC6 and ACC7 as underlying assets rather than separate PortCos.
Record July 25, 2023 as the legal close and July 27, 2023 as the public announcement date.
Do not infer a later transfer or exit; Digital Realty still reported its 20% interest at June 30, 2026.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact numbered TREP fund or feeder is not publicly disclosed.
The exact member and borrower chain beneath Nova DC Holdings is not publicly disclosed.
Tenant identities are not publicly disclosed.
